run_offline_ivf_evaluate: run the offline IVF evaluation on database vectors using a config yaml and slurm cluster
run_offline_ivf_train: run the offline IVF index training on database vectors with a specified index factory string
launch_slurm_job: launch a slurm job on the cluster using submitit with specified nodes and gpus
join_prod_nonprod_lists: join prod and non-prod lists from a dictionary, deduplicating the last prod value
process_options_and_run_jobs: process command line options and launch offline IVF jobs locally or on a slurm cluster
